decision: Add five append-only tables: certification_exchange_records (one row per version, exchanged attachment ids as a JSON list the command validates against the Case), certification_reverification_items and certification_reverification_withdrawals, certification_deadline_sets (Company-scoped versions carrying their idempotency key and fingerprint) and certification_procedure_events; widen the role, event, command and rule-code checks
why: An Exchange Record, an item, a withdrawal and a deadline set version are records with actor, time and reason; the Company event needs a Company-scoped table since certification_events requires a Case
result: Reviewed migration; the item scope index is created before the withdrawal foreign key

decision: Derive deadline states, automatic Re-verification Items and rules R06, R07, R15 and R16 on read; store nothing derived
why: PRD 9.2 says states are derived on read and never stored; replaying the pure check keeps open-since and corrected-by exact

decision: R16 compares a Stage 2 report sending recorded while no decision existed with "not recorded", and a later one with the decision date plus the configured days
why: PRD 8.2: breached when dated before D or recorded while no decision exists; a stable compared value keeps the approver's acceptance valid once the decision is recorded, which the decision gate evaluates on the candidate decision
evidence: certification-exchanges.rest.test.ts R16 test; certification-consistency.test.ts R16 tests

decision: The procedure deadline set is read and configured under the live company.assignment.manage Workspace right on the active Company, through a new Access method; Case members see the current set version in the Case read
why: PRD 11: the member holding the Company administration right that assigns the certification bundles configures it; Access owns the grant tables

decision: The rule set version becomes dossier-consistency-2026-11.2; an acceptance's re-verification flag adds a linked item in the resolution's transaction, recorded by the one discrepancy_resolved event with reverification=added
why: Adding rules changes the rule set; one event per command
